Messages.Author: D-dennis
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

This is the official announcement of the Belgian National V:tES Championship for 2015!
*** Belgian National Championship 2015 ***

Date: Sunday, December 6, 2015
Registration: 11:30
First round starting time: 12:00
Expected finishing time: 21:00

Type of Event: Standard Constructed
Detailed rules can be found on the VEKN Tournament Rules webpage:
www.vekn.net/index.php/tournament-rules

Number of rounds: 3 + final
Time limit per round: 2 hours

Address of Event:
Address of Event:
The Outpost
Rue de la Tribune 8
1000 Bruxelles
Belgium
www.outpost.be
Tel. +32 (0)2 2180400

Note that it is not allowed to bring your own drinks into the shop.
Food and drinks are available in the Outpost at affordable prizes.
Sleeves and other accessoires (Netrunner, ...) are available also

Entry fee: 5 euros

*** Pre-registration ***
Pre-registration is very useful to ensure appropriate prize support and a timely start of the tournament. If you intend to participate, please sign up as soon as possible by replying to this thread or by e-mail:
dennis_devriendt (at) hotmail (dot) com

*** How to reach ***
By train: The Outpost is situated less than 10 minutes walking from Brussels Central Station (Gare Centrale).
If you arrive from Paris/London, you will end up at Brussels South Station (Gare du Midi). From there, take the metro line 2 or line 6, direction "Simonis (Elisabeth)", get off after about 8 minutes at the stop "Madou", then walk 5 minutes to the Outpost.
By car: there is usually plenty of free parking space around Rue de la Tribune.
The cards for Danse Macabre will be legal for play at this event.
When using Danse Macabre cards they must be color printed on standard paper and inserted
into opaque sleeves before another Vampire: The Eternal Struggle or Jyhad card.
This requires opaque sleeves for the whole crypt and/or library.
Cards printed on card stock will not be accepted as legal-for-play.
Hope to see many people in Brussels on december 6!

Cheers,
Dennis

(check www.vtes.be for updates)

www.facebook.com/groups/vtes.belgium/
